corrections.source_says: Complete the structured outcome fields using the methods already described correctly in reported: whitespace-normalized complete final essays were embedded with Gemini Embedding 2, SEMANTIC_SIMILARITY, in 3,072 dimensions; D_c is mean squared Euclidean distance to the within-condition centroid, and HI_c = 1 - D_c/D_Human-Only. Uncertainty is a 95% percentile bootstrap interval from 5,000 resamples; no formal between-condition difference or equivalence test was performed. AI was available during production in the AI-assisted arms (Human-Only had none), so code the assisted outcome as ai_available_when_produced=yes and timing=immediate. Retain construct=diversity, question=across_people and unit=set.

Within-essay category diversity is not across-people diversity. Total-element means are 8.30 for Human-Only, 9.71 for Standard Chatbot, 9.66 for Engage-to-Unlock and 9.16 for Time-Matched Unlock; the four-condition omnibus F(3, 394)=4.66, p=.003 includes the non-randomized cohort. confirmed: The local markdown was read completely, including Appendices A-E. The PDF has 31 pages and identifies arXiv:2610.01518v1, 1 Oct 2026, with manuscript date 2026-09-11; the form's title and author list match (PDF p. 1; appendices pp. 26-31).

Phase 1 is an online randomized people study conducted through Prolific: Human-Only, Standard Chatbot and Engage-to-Unlock were randomly assigned, and diversity was scored on participants' final essays (PDF p. 6, sections 3.1-3.2; p. 9, section 3.5.3).

The analyzed counts are people: Human-Only 99, Standard Chatbot 98, Engage-to-Unlock 107 and Time-Matched Unlock 94; 398 is the analyzed total across both recruitment phases. The randomized phase exceeds the 50-person threshold without the separate cohort (PDF p. 6, section 3.2; p. 26, Table 3).

The 445 count refers to respondents who completed the session, not the number randomized. The pre-exclusion randomized counts are not reported, so the form's null n_randomized fields are appropriate (PDF p. 6, section 3.2).

Time-Matched Unlock recruited a separate sample excluding Phase 1 participants; comparisons involving it may reflect cohort differences. The form correctly limits online_rct to Phase 1 comparisons; the qualifying randomized component should not be relegated to observational context (PDF p. 6, section 3.1; p. 20, section 5.3).

The AI-only reference contains 100 generated essays, not participants, and is explicitly not a randomized condition; the pooled embedding analysis contains 498 essays (PDF p. 8, section 3.5.3; p. 9, Semantic Content and Dispersion).

Both assistant modes use gemini-3.1-pro-preview. The form correctly distinguishes Teach-me guidance from Tell-me generation and the requirement to select Tell-me after unlocking (PDF pp. 5-6, section 3.1; pp. 26-29, Appendix D).

Task 1 required at least 200 words about the four-day workweek using four source summaries. Task 2 evaluated eight 150-word AI-generated passages without assistance; both tasks had suggested, unenforced 20-minute durations (PDF p. 7, sections 3.3-3.4).

All numeric values in the existing reported string match Table 1: Standard Chatbot n=98, D_c=0.188 [0.178, 0.194], HI=-0.050 (-5.0%); Human-Only n=99, D_c=0.179 [0.167, 0.188], HI=0.000 (baseline). The existing one_line_finding also matches (PDF p. 13, Table 1).

The 95% intervals use 5,000 percentile bootstrap resamples. Negative homogenization indices indicate greater dispersion, and the authors explicitly decline formal tests of between-condition differences or equivalence; the existing reported string and one-line finding preserve this limitation (PDF p. 9, section 3.5.3; p. 13, Table 1 caption).
The unit=set and question=across_people fit within-condition dispersion around a centroid; PCA is explicitly a semantic-location analysis rather than a diversity measure (PDF p. 9, section 3.5.3).

Task 2 scores judgments of supplied AI passages, not creativity of participants' newly produced output, so its unassisted timing does not by itself establish an after_ai creative-output outcome (PDF p. 7, section 3.3; p. 10, section 3.5.5).

The supplement description is accurate: Table 3 demographics, Figure 6 task durations, Figure 7 lexical frequencies, assistant prompts and a sample conversation are included in Appendices A-E; dispersion estimates and bootstrap intervals are in main-text Table 1 (PDF pp. 26-31; p. 13).
This is an original two-phase experiment with a descriptive AI-only corpus, not a synthesis; no study-count or pooled meta-analytic estimate needs extraction (PDF pp. 5-9, section 3).
summary: Phase 1 randomly assigned people to writing conditions with scored essay diversity and analyzed arm counts of 99, 98 and 107, so this paper belongs in the two-screener pipeline. The recorded dispersion numbers and source version are correct, but core eligibility, company involvement, incomplete fields and omitted output results need correction.
